name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
September 11, 2007
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Reverend Michael Carr,
Recommended Action:
All Saints Episcopal Church*3
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session.
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring September 2007 "National Civic Awareness Month" in the City of Vista. (CC)
P2.
Proclamation declaring September 2007 "Emergency Preparedness Month" in the City of Vista. (CC)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
Recommended Action:
Receive the check register.
C2.
Ordinances on Agenda (CC)
Recommended Action:
Waive reading of ordinances on the agenda.
C3.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
Recommended Action:
Approve the following Minutes:
August 28, 2007, Regular Meeting (CC/BSD/CDC)
August 29, 2007, Special Joint Dinner Meeting (CC)
C4.
Second Reading of Ordinances (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt the following Ordinances:
1.
City Council Ordinance No. 2007-15, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Vista, California, Adding Chapter 8.74 to the Vista Municipal Code to Prohibit the Retail Sale or Distribution of Novelty Lighters";
2.
City Council Ordinance No. 2007-16, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Vista, California, Approving a Zone Change from R-1-B to Specific Plan Implementation (SPI) on a 3.3 Acre Site at 420 Lado de Loma Drive and Adoption of the Pheasant Hills Specific Plan"; and
3.
City Council Ordinance No. 2007-17, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Vista, California, Amending Chapters 18.04 and 18.12 Relating to City Projects."
C5.
Rideshare Week 2007 (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , proclaiming the week of October 1st "Rideshare Week 2007" in the City of Vista.
C6.
Beautification and Improvement Commission (CC)
Recommended Action:
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2007- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City of Vista, California, Repealing Chapter 2.52 Beautification and Improvement Commission and Disestablishing the Beautification and Improvement Commission."
C7.
Establishing Design Build Proposal Evaluation Criteria (CC)
Recommended Action:
Approve criteria for evaluating design build proposals.
C8.
Final Subdivision Map at 877 Sycamore Avenue (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving a Final Subdivision Map for a 24-lot residential subdivision.
C9.
Standardized Emergency Management System (SEMS) (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , adopting SEMS.
C10.
Amendment to the Agreement with Vinje & Middleton Engineering, Inc. (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving a second amendment to the consultant agreement for as-needed materials testing services for the City's Capital Improvement Projects, and authorizing the Mayor to execute the amendment.
C11.
Speed Limit on S. Emerald Drive/Sunset Drive (CC)
Recommended Action:
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2007- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Vista, California, Establishing a Prima Facie Speed Limit of 35 Miles Per Hour on S. Emerald Drive/Sunset Drive from W. Vista Way to the City Limit."
ITEMS REMOVED FROM CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
Traffic Control on Heather Drive at Alta Vista Drive (CC)
Recommended Action:
1.
Discuss the proposal for traffic control at the two intersections of Heather Drive and Alta Vista Drive, and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , establishing a stop on Heather Drive at its westerly approach to Alta Vista Drive, and an all-way stop at the easterly intersection of Alta Vista Drive and Heather Drive.
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
